description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Order No. 39 made to order that no manufacturer, importer etc. shall sell Mysore Dhal, Dried Sprats & 13 other items above the maximum retail prices given w.e.f. 14.07.2016
categorisation: This gazette content contains a regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes maximum retail prices for various consumer goods and rescinds previous orders, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or specialized administrative matter.
